subject.title: Show claude-swap accounts in CLI cards

question: Should enabling claude-swap automatically replace ambient Claude CLI cards for two or more accounts and make adapter failures return a non-zero cards exit status?
rationale: These are user-visible default and failure-semantics changes for existing opted-in installations, and no maintainer discussion in the supplied PR context explicitly confirms that the menu-bar policy should govern the CLI.

options.title: Approve documented precedence
options.body: Adopt the branch's cards-only precedence and non-zero failure behavior after the contributor supplies real terminal proof.

options.title: Require explicit CLI opt-in
options.body: Keep ambient cards as the CLI default and require a dedicated cards flag or setting before showing claude-swap accounts.

options.title: Preserve successful exit fallback
options.body: Use automatic precedence but retain a successful exit when useful ambient output remains available after an adapter failure.

recommendation.title: Approve documented precedence
recommendation.body: Adopt the branch's cards-only precedence and non-zero failure behavior after the contributor supplies real terminal proof.

likelyOwner.reason: The choice controls CodexBar's public CLI defaults and compatibility behavior, making the repository owner the best available decision route.
